reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_code,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(o.order_ts) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q1_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(o.order_ts) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q2_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(o.order_ts) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q3_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(o.order_ts) = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q4_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(o.order_ts) = 3) AS q3_orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(o.order_ts) = 4) AS q4_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id

  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code
other_way.tradeoff: COUNT with FILTER gives 0 on its own when no order matches, so it needs no ELSE, but older engines lack FILTER.
